props.text: Running five trucks or fifty? Our fleet desk handles spec’ing, volume pricing, lease-versus-buy comparisons and scheduled PM so your whole operation runs off one account.
Our service trucks handle PM, diagnostics and minor repairs on site, Monday to Saturday — so trucks keep working while the work gets done.

items.q: Do I need an appointment for service?
items.a: Appointments get you the fastest turnaround, but every Summit Ridge location takes walk-ins for inspections and quick repairs when bays are open.
Yes. Summit Ridge Road Assist answers (555) 010-0199 from 6:00 PM to 7:00 AM every night and dispatches a technician or tow.

items.q: Can I pick up parts ordered online here?
items.a: Yes. Choose this location at checkout and most in-stock orders are ready at the parts counter the same day.

items.q: Do you rent or lease trucks from this location?
items.a: Short-term rentals and full-service leases are available — our fleet desk can tell you what is on the lot here today.
